name: Genaro Britton III
source:
Genaro is the current king of Angielle, and father of Lucette. He is loved by his subjects, his second wife, and his step children; however, he has a very distant relationship with his daughter Lucette.
[spoiler]Genaro was forced to marry and raped by Hildyr after she murdered his father.
[/spoiler]
